user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospitals to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the hospital point geometries from EPSG:4326 into the census tract CRS EPSG:26918 so the spatial join can use compatible CRSs.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the input hospital vector layer to EPSG:26918 without changing its attributes. Preserve the hospital features and fields.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Join each hospital point to the census tract polygon that contains it and retain the tract identifier with the hospital attributes.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a point-in-polygon containment spatial join between hospitals_projected and input_2. Retain the hospital attributes and append the containing tract identifier, using the observed census-tract identifier field. Ground any runtime field and predicate configuration from the observed schemas; do not infer alternative join keys.

requirements.scope: The two vector inputs to assign_hospitals_to_census_tracts must use compatible coordinate reference systems for the containment spatial join.
The projected hospital input must retain fields sufficient to identify each hospital in the output, including ID and NAME.
The census tract input must contain the tract identifier field GEOID to satisfy the requested output.
Both spatial-join inputs must contain valid, non-empty geometries.
Both spatial-join inputs must be supplied in a vector format supported by the worker.

Binary spatial operations require compatible coordinate reference systems. Distance operations use the coordinate system and units of the provided input artifact.

skills.name: Vector Geoprocessing
skills.description: Performs spatial buffering, clipping, polygon intersection overlay, geometry validation/repair, and spatial joins.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for binary operations. Distance operations require projected coordinate reference systems.
other: The service performs only the requested operation.
